paper.note: COMPOUNDING: margin per new position = 5% of realized balance, notional = margin × 3 leverage (already-open positions keep their original size). Paper only — no real orders or API keys. 0.05% taker fee per side on notional, fill at the confirmation candle close. One open position per coin, traded only on the active timeframe (5m). TP +$2 net (after fees), an opposite signal, or liquidation, whichever first. After any close, that coin has a 3-minute cooldown and cannot open (a flip close does not open the other side immediately). A take-profit or liquidation just closes the trade (no flip). Positions are not closed on fade, timeout, or stop.

paper_unconfirmed.note: COMPOUNDING: margin per new position = 5% of realized balance, notional = margin × 3 leverage (already-open positions keep their original size). DCA legs match the first leg. Paper only — no real orders or API keys. 0.05% taker fee per side on notional. Enters at the close of the candle when a new unconfirmed BUY?/SELL? first appears on the active timeframe (5m). One open position per coin. If that signal fades, the position stays open. DCA: add a leg every 3rd same-direction signal, max 4 adds. Each add matches the first leg's notional, with no fade required. An opposite unconfirmed signal closes the whole stack. TP +$2 net (after fees), an opposite signal, or liquidation, whichever first. After any close, that coin has a 3-minute cooldown and cannot open (a flip close does not open the other side immediately). A take-profit or liquidation just closes the stack (no flip). Positions are not closed on fade, timeout, or stop.

adx.note: Same rules as the 1-minute ADX scanner (ADX ≥ 25 and rising, fresh +DI/−DI cross). Read-only; does not change the alert routine's state.
